query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patent_analyses (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  patent_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  organization_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  chemical_compounds TEXT,
  reaction_mechanisms TEXT,
  processing_conditions TEXT,
  technology_category VARCHAR(255),
  key_innovations TEXT,
  competitor_analysis TEXT,
  market_applications TEXT,
  formulation_strategies TEXT,
  material_suggestions TEXT,
  process_optimizations TEXT,
  analysis_date VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  analyzed_by VARCHAR(255),
  confidence VARCHAR(255),
  notes TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (patent_id) REFERENCES patents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS literature_papers (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  authors TEXT,
  journal VARCHAR(255),
  publication_year VARCHAR(255),
  doi VARCHAR(255),
  abstract TEXT,
  full_text LONGTEXT,
  pdf_url TEXT,
  source_url TEXT,
  keywords TEXT,
  uploaded_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  created_at VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS literature_analyses (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  paper_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  organization_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  key_findings TEXT,
  methodologies TEXT,
  experimental_conditions TEXT,
  results TEXT,
  chemical_compounds TEXT,
  reaction_mechanisms TEXT,
  formulation_insights TEXT,
  relevance_score VARCHAR(255),
  applicability TEXT,
  recommendations TEXT,
  analysis_date VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  analyzed_by VARCHAR(255),
  notes TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (paper_id) REFERENCES literature_papers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
